verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting continuously evaluates rules and sends notifications to external systems such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie (grafana-gh-7). The docs also describe taking action on alerts and escalating them via on-call (grafana-docs-10, grafana-docs-6). However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents a generic webhook contact point or wiring alerts to automated remediation or agents. Missing for 10: explicit webhook contact point documentation, evidence of alert-triggered automation or agent invocation, payload/integration details, independent hands-on corroboration.
